briefdescription.para: This function asserts the DC block reset and releases SS_CFG_POR in MMI_CRX.RST_DC, whatever state the boot CDO left them in.

detaileddescription.para: The DC is then configured in reset. XDpDc_ReleaseDcReset() takes it out of reset after DP link training.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if RST_DC reads back as requested, else XST_FAILURE

briefdescription.para: This function releases the DC block reset in MMI_CRX.RST_DC.

detaileddescription.para: Call it after DP link training and before the DP video stream is configured. The DP video stream registers do not latch while the DC block reset is asserted.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if RST_DC reads back released, else XST_FAILURE

briefdescription.para: This function returns the video clock rate the XSA programs at boot, which is the rate the PL video pipeline is timed for.

detaileddescription.para: The rate is read on the first call and cached, so the first call must come before XDpDc_InitClkWiz() reprograms the clock.

simplesect.para: Boot rate in Hz, or 0 if it cannot be read, the clock may already have been reprogrammed or the design has no clock wizard.
